properties.description:
Basis: Confirmed: spotter/public report

SPC filtered hail 261022 (added late: 2.00" 1 NE Linden 2300Z) = IEM/NWS LSR HAIL 2.00 (qualifier M, Trained Spotter, NWS Flagstaff, product 202610232132-KFGZ issued 10/23 21:32Z). Same storm: 1.25" M trained spotter Linden 23:24Z. DISCREPANCY: LSR codes it "measured" but the remark says "estimated to be around 2 inches" from a photo - treated as spotter/public (rank 2), not measured. MRMS MESH (24h ending 10/23 12Z) at the report: 1.80". HailTrace public 10/22 page did not list it at the 10/23 run (late report).
